integrity: The exact formula is proved by a bijection with ordered joint-eigenspace decompositions and orbit-stabilizer. Exhaustive computations over small prime fields are consistency checks, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The tuple formula concerns idempotents only. The probability asymptotic holds for fixed matrix size as the field grows. The original 1960 Feit–Fine article was not available as full text in this run; its unrestricted theorem was checked through a full-text later reproof.
title: Exact enumeration of commuting idempotent tuples in finite matrix algebras
